headline: Operating gains offset by higher D&A, interest, and tax

highlights: Per (%) -10/-23/-22 12M Avg Val (INR M) 1837 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 91.2 106.6 118.2 EBITDA 20.8 23.9 28.0 Adj.
Hospital revenue grew 18.8% YoY, aided by higher patient volumes and a 6.1% improvement in ARPP.  Occupancy improved, despite addition of beds, to 72% in 2QFY27 (vs. 71% in 2QFY26).

Higher realization per patient further supported growth as well as profitability in the Hospital segment.  FORH also continues to expand its network, with the acquisition of 110-bed Suguna Hospital in Bengaluru and a long-term healthcare services agreement for a 400+ bed hospital in Ashok Vihar, Delhi.
valuation: Per (%) -10/-23/-22 12M Avg Val (INR M) 1837 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 91.2 106.6 118.2 EBITDA 20.8 23.9 28.0 Adj.

Reiterate BUY  We reduce our earnings estimates by 4%/7% for FY27/FY28, factoring in: a) the ramp-up of newer beds diluting margins in the initial phase, and b) margins caps with respect to oncology drugs.  We assign 25x/23x 12M forward EV/EBITDA to the company’s hospital/diagnostics businesses, respectively, and arrive at an SOTP-based TP of INR940.
